about_the_game:
Hatsune Miku "Magical Mirai 2025 Ver." DLC Arrives on Desktop Mate!

We've implemented completely new motions and effects that reflect the Magical Mirai 2025 theme, "Starlight Sky" (星河一天). Your desktop will come alive with special movements and performances that set this apart from the standard Hatsune Miku DLC.

The outfit, based on the deep blue of the starry sky, features meticulously reproduced details. These include ring-shaped accessories reminiscent of celestial bodies and kimono-style sleeves adorned with stardust patterns on the inside.

  • Hatsune Miku's highly anticipated newly recorded voice makes its debut in the "Magical Mirai 2025 Ver."

  • Beautiful graphics and natural movements powered by the latest 3D technology.

  • A specially created 3D model.

  • Please note that this DLC will be available until June 30, 2026. The period may be extended or resold as the case may be.

  • Desktop Mate is required to use this content. Please update to the latest version before use.

  • This content must be used in accordance with the “PIAPRO CHARACTER LICENSE”.

  • According to this license, this content may be used for video distribution on platforms such as YouTube, NicoNico Douga, and Twitch.

Content Included in This Product:

Hatsune Miku "Magical Mirai 2025 Ver."
